description: This Java interface defines a contract for extending or wrapping message mappers within the connectivity mapping of the Eclipse Ditto framework. It specifies a single method to instantiate or wrap a message mapper given connection details and an actor system.

classes.name: MessageMapperExtension
classes.description: A functional interface to extend or wrap message mappers created within a specific connection context and actor system.

methods.name: apply
methods.description: Creates or wraps a MessageMapper instance based on the provided connection ID, existing mapper, and actor system; may return null if instantiation is not possible.
